selected_concept.selection_rule: Choose the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of UTF-8 731552:<candidate_id>.

target.reference_priority_boundary: General visible adult appearance cues may inform the subject, but the designed face-shape target takes priority over the reference outline. No identity or biometric claim is made.

prompt_en: Inside a partially flooded Baroque archive, the scene centers an unmistakably adult woman conservation scientist aligning a vellum leaf beneath a raised glass platen as a chandelier-like pulley drying rack turns under a dripping painted dome. The supplied image informs general adult appearance, while the designed diamond zygomatic-dominant face contour takes priority over the reference outline. A restrained frontal waist-up portrait ensures the full hairline temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter remains visible, with hair pinned away from temples, cheek edges, jaw corners, and chin. The face length-to-width relation remains readable; cheekbone width exceeds forehead and jaw widths; the contour narrows toward both forehead and small chin; front-view width remains separate from depth lighting and styling. Her expression is neutral. Soft bilateral face-shaping light and low-distortion portrait perspective keep both facial sides legible while one gloved hand works the vellum and the other steadies a humidity sensor. Gilded shelves, suspended catalog ribbons, reflected candles, shallow water, ornate stucco, and conservation tools form layered architectural depth behind her.

overall_reason: The candidate, composed-prompt, and exact runtime audits passed, but the sole authorized image call failed before returning pixels, so none of the five visual gates can be technically adjudicated.
